  Repeat.

Start: Lightning Storm (hand); Stormchaser Drake (battlefield); Wheel of Sun and Moon (battlefield); Abundance (battlefield); Sakashima the Impostor (battlefield)

  Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
Steps: Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
  Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
  Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
  Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
  Repeat from step 2.
  Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.

  When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
  Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Aerith.
  When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
  Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
  Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 2 and 5.
  Repeat.
Notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{G}{G} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Feather, the Redeemed (battlefield); Sage of Hours (battlefield); Strength of the Tajuru (hand)
Steps: Cast Strength of the Tajuru by paying {4}{G}{G}, targeting Sage of Hours.
  Sage of Hours and Feather trigger.
  Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Feather trigger, causing you to exile Strength of the Tajuru as it resolves.

  Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
  At the beginning of your end step, Feather triggers, returning Strength of the Tajuru from exile to your hand.
  Repeat each turn.

## Combo 1494-1954-4613-7152
Cards: The Thing + Agatha's Soul Cauldron + Sage of Hours + Change of Heart
Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{R}{G}{W}{W}{U} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: The Thing (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Agatha's Soul Cauldron (battlefield); Sage of Hours (exile: exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron); Change of Heart (hand)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
Steps: Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}, returning it to your hand.
  At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
  Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
  Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Repeat each turn.
Notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Change of Heart. Change of Heart is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

## Combo 1494-1991-2744
Cards: Tana, the Bloodsower + Sage of Hours + Cathars' Crusade
Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Tana, the Bloodsower (battlefield); Sage of Hours (battlefield); Cathars' Crusade (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Steps: Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
  Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
  When the Saprolings enter the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
  Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
  Repeat each turn.

Steps: Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
  Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.

  Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
  Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.

## Combo 1916-3086-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Changeling Titan + Lagrella, the Magpie
Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand

Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Lagrella, the Magpie (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Lagrella enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Lagrella until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).
